title: 第15课 · 我是坐飞机来的
subtitle: HSK 1 · Lesson 15 — 我是坐飞机来的 · I came here by air

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在餐桌旁 — At the dining table

items.zh: A：你和李小姐是什么时候认识的？
items.py: A: Nǐ hé Lǐ xiǎojiě shì shénme shíhou rènshi de?
items.en: A: When did you and Miss Li meet?

items.py: B: Wǒmen shì èr líng yī yī nián jiǔ yuè rènshi de.
A: Nǐmen zài nǎr rènshi de?

items.zh: B：我们是在学校认识的，她是我大学同学。
items.py: B: Wǒmen shì zài xuéxiào rènshi de, tā shì wǒ dàxué tóngxué.
items.en: B: We met at school. She was my university classmate.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在饭店门口 — Outside a hotel

items.py: A: Nǐmen shì zěnme lái fàndiàn de?
items.en: A: How did you get to the hotel?

items.py: B: Wǒmen shì zuò chūzūchē lái de.
A: Lǐ xiānsheng ne?

items.zh: B：他是和朋友一起开车来的。
items.py: B: Tā shì hé péngyou yìqǐ kāi chē lái de.
items.en: B: He drove here with a friend.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在公司 — In the company

items.py: A: Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nín! Lǐ xiǎojiě.
items.en: A: Nice to meet you, Miss Li.

items.py: B: Rènshi nǐ wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng!
items.en: B: Nice to meet you too.

items.zh: A：听张先生说，您是坐飞机来北京的？
items.py: A: Tīng Zhāng xiānsheng shuō, nín shì zuò fēijī lái Běijīng de?
items.en: A: Mr Zhang said you came to Beijing by plane?

items.py: B: Shì de.

items.py: Wǒ shì zuótiān lái de.

items.en: How did you come to the hotel?

items.py: Wǒ bú shì zuótiān lái de.
items.en: I didn't come yesterday (是 can't be dropped here).

items.zh: 我们不是坐出租车来的。
items.py: Wǒmen bú shì zuò chūzūchē lái de.

items.py: Míngtiān shì èr líng yī sì nián wǔ yuè shíyī hào.
Jīntiān jiǔ yuè shí hào, xīngqī sān.
Wǒmen shì èr líng yī yī nián jiǔ yuè rènshi de.

items.zh: 她们是什么时候认识的？
items.py: Tāmen shì shénme shíhou rènshi de?
Tāmen shì zài nǎr rènshi de?
Tāmen shì zěnme qù fàndiàn de?
items.en: How did they go to the hotel?

items.zh: 李先生是坐出租车去饭店的吗？
items.py: Lǐ xiānsheng shì zuò chūzūchē qù fàndiàn de ma?
items.en: Did Mr Li go to the hotel by taxi?

items.zh: 李小姐是怎么来北京的？
items.py: Lǐ xiǎojiě shì zěnme lái Běijīng de?
items.en: How did Miss Li come to Beijing?

items.zh: 中国常用的通信工具有电话和手机。
items.py: Zhōngguó chángyòng de tōngxìn gōngjù yǒu diànhuà hé shǒujī.
items.en: Common ways to communicate in China: landlines and mobile phones.

items.py: Diànhuà hàomǎ yìbān shì liù dào bā wèi.
items.en: Landline numbers usually have 6 to 8 digits.

items.py: Shǒujī hàomǎ dōu shì shíyī wèi.
yāo sān jiǔ – líng yāo líng qī – bā bā liù liù
items.en: Mobile numbers are read in groups of 3-4-4; 1 is read yāo.
